claims.claim: Second-quarter 2026 reported sales grew 6.6% to $25.3 Billion.
Second-quarter 2026 operational sales growth was 5.6%.
Second-quarter 2026 adjusted operational sales growth was 5.7%.
Second-quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.27.
Second-quarter 2026 adjusted diluted EPS was $2.90.
The company increased its full-year 2026 guidance.
Full-year 2026 estimated reported sales guidance is $100.8 Billion to $101.4 Billion, with a midpoint of $101.1 Billion.
The estimated reported sales guidance midpoint represents a 7.3% increase versus the prior year.
Adjusted EPS guidance for 2026 was raised by $0.13.
Adjusted EPS guidance for 2026 is a range of $11.60 to $11.75 with a midpoint of $11.68.
The adjusted EPS guidance midpoint reflects an 8.2% increase versus the prior year.
Innovative Medicine worldwide operational sales grew 6.8%.

Innovative Medicine growth was primarily driven by DARZALEX, CARVYKTI, TECVAYLI and RYBREVANT/LAZCLUZE in Oncology, TREMFYA and Other Immunology in Immunology, and SPRAVATO and CAPLYTA in Neuroscience.
MedTech worldwide operational sales grew 3.6%.

MedTech growth was supported by wound closure products and biosurgery products in Surgery, electrophysiology products and Shockwave in Cardiovascular, contact lenses in Vision, and trauma in Orthopaedics.
Innovative Medicine growth was partially offset by STELARA and REMICADE in Immunology, as well as IMBRUVICA and ZYTIGA in Oncology.
MedTech growth was negatively impacted by net acquisitions and divestitures by 10 basis points.
Innovative Medicine growth was negatively impacted by divestitures by 10 basis points.

Johnson & Johnson does not provide GAAP financial measures on a forward-looking basis due to uncertainty regarding legal proceedings, unusual gains and losses, acquisition-related expenses, and purchase accounting fair value adjustments.
The company raised its 2026 adjusted operational sales guidance to a range of 6.2% - 6.8% versus the prior year, with a midpoint of 6.5%.
2026 adjusted operational EPS guidance was increased to a range of $11.50 - $11.65 with a midpoint of $11.58.
The adjusted operational EPS guidance midpoint represents a 7.3% increase versus the prior year.
Second-quarter year-to-date free cash flow was estimated at approximately $8.7 Billion as of July 15, 2026.
The company announced an investment of more than $1 Billion to strengthen U.S. Vision manufacturing in Jacksonville, Florida.
DePuy Synthes appointed Christina Zamarro as Chief Financial Officer.
Divestitures negatively impacted Innovative Medicine operational sales by 10 basis points in the quarter.
The company explicitly states it cannot predict the outcome of legal proceedings and unusual gains or losses with reasonable certainty for forward-looking periods.
There is a planned separation of the Orthopaedics business with anticipated benefits the company aims to realize.
